Officers: Met = Chair & Counselor/Advisor both present   Partial = only one present   Not Met = neither present. In the detail panel, required officer chips (Chair, Counselor/Advisor) show red when missing; optional officer chips (Vice Chair, Secretary, Treasurer, Webmaster) show yellow when missing.
